lines.t: The butterfly dances, a tender romance
As softly they glide through the wide open sky
Their wings catch the air in a beautiful prayer
And carry them onward in graceful flight
The male's lovely wings wear their delicate scales
A quiet display as he reaches his mate
The female draws near, together they sail
Two colors unfolding in patterns so bright
The Lord's grand design brings a cocoon to rest
Hung from a leaf as the days pass along
A hidden beginning, a patient new life
Preparing to open its wings to the dawn
This season takes time, there is no need to hurry
The wonder is growing where no one can see
And when it is ready, the wings will unfold
A lovely new story set free in the breeze
From a cocoon to a butterfly
A new creation rises and comes alive
With a language of beauty known only to them
Their song moves gently through the air
And there in their motion
A praise is revealed
A melody flowing
A wonder made real
Praise Yahushua our King
Who reigns on high
Give Him glory forever, who taught us to fly
Praise Yahushua our King, who reigns on high
Give Him glory forever, who taught us to fly
Giving glory forever
Who taught us to fly
